name: Sezze (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and navy blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sezze (a lion on red) in a red panel bordered yellow with the motto SETIA PLENA BONIS GERIT ALBIS SIGNA LEONIS.
history: Municipal flag of Sezze, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sezze arms — lion on red within a yellow-bordered panel with the motto SETIA PLENA BONIS GERIT ALBIS SIGNA LEONIS
